cmd: echo "=== apt install ffmpeg + carlito ==="; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y >/tmp/apt.log 2>&1; sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ffmpeg fonts-crosextra-carlito >>/tmp/apt.log 2>&1; tail -15 /tmp/apt.log; echo; echo "=== pip install edge-tts ==="; pip install edge-tts --break-system-packages 2>&1 | tail -10; echo; echo "=== verify ==="; ffmpeg -version | head -1; python3 -c "import edge_tts; print("edge_tts OK", edge_tts.__file__)"; find /usr/share/fonts -iname "Carlito-Regular.ttf"; python3 -c "import numpy, PIL; print("numpy/PIL OK")"
